tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /so 'brang 'khor lo bcu gsum ma'i rab gnas dang 'dogs tshul thun mong ma yin pa'i gsal byed 'dod dgu'i re skong bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ma hā pra ti pa re ya/ 'dir 'phags ma so sor 'brang ma'i srung 'khor rgyas pa phan yon can 'khor lo bcu gsum ma'i bri yig 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung rab nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin 'bri ba'am par du btab la/ pho mo'i khyad par gyi rdzas dang dri bzang gis byugs/ de la rab gnas thun mong ba don gsal sogs nas 'byung ba bzhin dang / thun mong ma yin pa 'dogs tshul bcas 'dir 'bri na/ bsrung ba lte ba'i sngags phreng gi zhal rang nyid ngos la bstan pa bzhag de'i mthar/ mchod pa'i tshogs ci 'byor pa bshams/ de nas stan la 'khod do/ /sngon 'gro gtor ma nas brtsams te/ lha'i rnal 'byor bzlas pa la thug gi bar/ kho bos brtsams pa'i sgrub dkyil nas 'byung ba bzhin/ rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis bdag la bsrung du gsol gyi bar bya/ de nas khrus sna kun 'dus kyi bum pa yod na bum bskyed mi dgos/ med na tshe dpag med sogs nas 'byung ba bzhin las bum sgrub/ zhi ba dang zhi drag phyed ma dang / drag po'i sbyong ba rnams rab gnas kyi gzhung gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin la/ 'dir 'phags ma so sor 'brang ma'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rab gnas bgyid pa la zhes dang / bden bdar gyi tshe/ khyad par bcom ldan 'das ma bsrung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / zhes sbyar/ sdig pa sbyong ba dang dri ma sbyong ba rab gnas bzhin rgyas pa'am/ khrus gsol mdor bsdus kyi rung / de nas 'khor lo a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhās sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du 'khor lo'i lte bar pad+ma 'dab brgyad de'i phyir mu khyud/ de'i phyir pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i mtshams bzhi la rdo rje rgya gram gyi phyogs bzhi'i rwa/

de'i phyir pad 'dab nyer lnga/ de'i phyir mu khyud gsum/ de'i phyir pad 'dab lnga bcu rtsa drug de'i phyir mu khyud kyis bskor ba dang / 'khor lo'i phyi rol shar lho'i zur gyi dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad mu khyud gnyis pa/ de'i g.yas su pad+ma 'dab bzhi g.yon du pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ lho nub kyi dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi mu khyud gnyis pa/ g.yas su pad+ma 'dab bzhi/ g.yon du pad+ma 'dab drug nub byang gi dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad mu khyud gnyis pa/ g.yas su pad+ma 'dab bzhi/ g.yon du 'khor lo rtse lnga/ byang shar gyi dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad mu khyud gnyis pa/ g.yas su pad+ma 'dab bzhi g.yon du 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ de rnams kyi phyir mu khyud gcig gis bskor ba dang bcas pa'i 'khor lo dbus ma'i mu khyud bcu pa'i nang du pad ma'i nang du/ phyag mtshan/ rin po che/ 'khor lo/ rgyal mtshan/ mda'/ gzhu/ phur pa/ dung / mi mgo rdo rje/ gdugs/ dpal ye/ tho ba/ rtse gsum/ satwa gri/ gri gug ral gri/ rgya gram/ rdo rje zhags pa/ lcags kyu/ mda'/ nya/ bum pa/ pad+ma/ dbyug tho/ mdung / 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi/ lnga/ drug brgyad/ brag ri/ gtun shing / rnams la dar gyi lda ldis brgyan pa bcu gnyis pa la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba/ 'khor lo bcu gsum po thams cad kyi phyir ye shes kyi me ri 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i 'khor lo'i steng gi yig 'bru rnams praṃ las 'khor lo praṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ma chen mo nas/ byang chub kyi shing drung na bzhugs pa'o'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ de'i thugs ka'i praṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ spro na/ ma lus sems can sogs ye shes pa spyan 'dren gyi tshig rgyas pa rnams dang / byon legs sogs dkyil chog bzhin bya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥmang du brjod pas bstim/

slar yang thugs ka'i praṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyang rab gnas bzhin spyan drangs la bstim/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs dang / dbang lha spyan drangs/ dbang bskur rgyas btab/ oṃ ma hā pra ti pa re sngon du 'gro bas mchod/ rang bzhin dag pa nyid las byung sogs kyis bstod/ rab gnas bzhin spyan dbye byas la de nas ming spel bsrung bya gang yin du bskyed la/ rdo rje nang bsdams las mdzub mo gnyis lcags kyu ltar bkug mthe'u chung gnyis gshibs te brkyangs/ mthe bong gshibs te brkyangs pas gung mo mnan pa'i phyag rgya/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐ dza/ zhes pa/ phyag rgya dang bcas pas rang ngam bsgrub bya'am/ yul grong la sogs pa bkug nas/ sngar bskyed pa rnams la thim par bsgom/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ri ṇi ma hā pra ti pa re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ 'chang ba po la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru swāhā/ oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bhā wa he tun+te ṣan+ta thā ga te h+ya ba data/ te ṣañtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā di ma hā shra ma ṇaḥswāhā/ oṃ a mṛ ta ba re wa ra wa ra pra wa ra bi shud+dhe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ a mṛ ta bi lo ki ni gar+bha paṃ rak+ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ bi ma le/ bi pu le dza la wa re a mṛ te bi ra dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ bha ra bha ra saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra in+d+ra ya ba la bi sho dha ni ru ru tsa le hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ 'chang ba po la nad gdon shīn+taṃ༞ tshe dang bsod nams puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru༞ oṃ a mṛ ta dha ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ 'chang ba po la rak+ṣa/ oṃ bhi po ta ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ bhi ma le hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ dza ya wa re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ 'chang ba po zhes so/ /oṃ ni suṃ bha badz+ra ni dha ra ka s+ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ a bha waṃ dzaṃ haṃ he te phi ta/ oṃ ka la kar ni hrī/ oṃ pad+ma kun dha li baṃ/ oṃ pu ta dan ti ni hūm̐/

oṃ na ma ku sha hūm̐/ oṃ na ma shi ka le haṃ/ oṃ ma hā shan te hūm̐/ oṃ ma hā ka la hrī/ oṃ du pe du te/ oṃ badz+ra ke le hri/ oṃ badz+ra ni pri ta hūm̐/ oṃ pa ni bhi ta ya oṃ badz+ra pa ni ma hā bha la dhi/ oṃ badz+ra ma le maṃ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa le swāhā/ oṃ dza la dza la hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ ḍāk+ki rā dza hūm̐ dza swāhā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de'i phyi bdun pa la/ oṃ badz+ra hrīḥ oṃ sum bha ni ke shrī tri hā/ oṃ bha ga laṃ/ oṃ bha ru me dza hūm̐/ oṃ shān+ti hūm̐/ oṃ pa ti pa la ba ra dha ni ta/ oṃ bha ra ke hūm̐/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na ma dha ri hrīḥ oṃ ma hā pa ti ma ra baṃ/ oṃ dhu ru bhu ru/ mu ru mu ru ku ru ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ ba ra ba ra dha ni mo hā/ oṃ ru ru tsa le hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ri ṇi ma hā pra ti pa re/ 'chang ba po la༞ oṃ ta re tāṃ/ oṃ a a rak+ṣa s+ye ka dza ta na dha ka ri he hūm̐/ oṃ ka pa li ni/ oṃ laṃ ke sha ra khaṃ aṃ/ dharmya la ka sha twe sum/ oṃ ha ri te haṃ k+ṣa/ oṃ pan tsi ka tra/ oṃ la khaṃ pa duṣ+ṭa/ oṃ dhan dhi ni ku ta/ oṃ sha ka ma dhe bheṣ+ka/ oṃ sa ra sa ra ṣ+ṭa baṃ/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣaḥ 'chang ba po la sarba rak+ṣaḥ sarba tsa ma gha baṃ/ oṃ dho bhi pad+ma maṃ/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ri ma ma ki maṃ oṃ bri bh+ruṃ bruṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ pa su sha pa laṃ k+ṣa k+ṣa dhu e ta bruṃ/ ka kha ha baṃ hrī dza hūm̐ hrī ḍa hūm̐ laṃ hrī suṃ hūm̐ dza baṃ su hūm̐ oṃ phaṭa dza paṃ māṃ ka baṃ oṃ su bha baṃ a sa bha ba a ya bh+ya ba oṃ trik+ṣa ha dhi shaṃ dza ru ru oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho aṃ a ā/ i ī/ u u/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ āḥ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa dha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa dha/ rten 'brel snying po taṃ/ oṃ ka s+ya rak+ṣa swāhā/ rak+ṣa dha ra 'chang ba༞ ta re tut+tā re tu re swāhā/

hūm̐ si gaṃ bh+rūṃ maṃ/ de lta bus sngags rnams ji ltar rigs pa bzlas la rdor thal sbyar nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang mas bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po'i bar chad thams cad bsrung zhing byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdug dkar mo can gyi sku de nyid zhu nas/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lor bris pa'i rnam par gyur/ de'i mtshan dang dpe byad rnams zhu nas dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi yi ger gyur/ bris pa'i 'khor lo rnams kyi lte ba dang 'dab ma rtsibs mu khyud sogs la gnas par gyur/ ces brjod la mchod/ mnyam med mas bstod/ brten bzhugs kyi tshig brjod/ ye dharmā dang bkra shis brjod la/ bsrung ba la me tog gtor/ de ltar rab gnas legs par byas pa'i bsrung ba de nyid g.yon g.yas 'og steng rnams nas lte ba ma chag par bltab pa la rgyas par na dkar/ sngo/ ser/ dmar/ ljang gu'i chings dang / bsdu na dar ras dkar po gang rung gi skud pas rgya gram du bcings/ dri bzang thor bu dang bcas pa'i na bza' lnga brtsegs sam dkar pos sgril/ 'khor lo dbus ma'i lte ba'i yig mgo ma nor bar byas la slar yang rab gnas mdor bsdus bya/ gzungs grwa lnga'i dbang byed na bsrung ba lnga'i gras su 'khor lo ster ran pa dang de sbyin/ dus gzhan du gang la ster ba de mdun du bos la skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa phog la/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ byab bsrung las byung ba ltar/ bsrungs shig ces pa'i tshig rnams brjod/ sngar bshad pa ltar gyi bsrung ba de lta bu sbyin bdag gi mgul du btags/ de nas slob dpon gyis me tog dang bcas pas/ 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste// //zhus so// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 kun dga' blo gros/ so 'brang 'khor lo bcu gsum ma'i rab gnas dang 'dogs tshul thun min/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
